title: 汇丰资管Beth Wong：如何甄选中国科技赢家？成本与技术双领先
speaker: Beth Wong

segments.en: I think, first of all, the market share, it's a very big, determining factor, being like a leader in terms of having the ability to source lower cost inputs are definitely key.
segments.zh: 首先，市场份额是一个很大的决定因素，作为领导者，能够获取更低成本的投入品绝对是关键。

segments.en: Of course, like the technology leadership, it's very important. So I think the performance per cost factor, it's also very important as well.
segments.zh: 当然，技术领先非常重要。我认为性价比因素也非常重要。

segments.en: So I would say the ability to develop in-house first-in-class technology, along with market share leadership, to be able to source lower cost inputs would be quite key.
segments.zh: 所以我认为，具备自主研发一流技术的能力，加上市场份额领先，并能获取低成本投入，这相当关键。
